LESSON: DECIMALS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.7: Decimals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Decimals, part of Numbers in Grade 5 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: Where can you use decimals in real life? 2. 2. What is the importance of ordering decimals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work out place value of decimals up to thousandths using a place value chart,

2. order decimals up to thousandths from smallest to largest and from largest to smallest using different methods,

3. work out addition of decimals up to thousandths using place value apparatus,

4. subtract decimals up to thousandths using place value apparatus,

5. collaborate with peers to find information on application of decimals in real-life situations. 1. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work out place value of decimals up to thousandths using a place value chart,
2. order decimals up to thousandths from smallest to largest and from largest to smallest using different methods,
3. work out addition of decimals up to thousandths using place value apparatus,
4. subtract decimals up to thousandths using place value apparatus,
5. collaborate with peers to find information on application of decimals in real-life situations. 1. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Decimals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Unity: learner collaborates with peers to find information on application of decimals in real-life situations

• Social justice: learner shares information on the application of decimals in real-life situations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: learner collaborates with peers to find information on application of decimals.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of decimal numbers to reading quantities of ingredients in Agriculture.
